en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Bahr, from Mihzam Al Asady, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you take the oil upon your convenience, so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> for the grace and the beauty and the love, and I seek Refuge with You<sup>azwj</sup> from the disgrace, and the ugliness and the detestation’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from al-Hassan ibn Bahr from Mehzam al-Asadiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you take oil in your palm, say, ‘O Lord, I ask You to grant me grace, beauty and love. I ask from You protection against abhorrence, disgrace and anger.’ Then place it on your forehead and say whatever you can.’”
